payload.title: scripts/dev/ensure_kanbus.sh fails in cloud containers with a Debian-managed PyYAML
payload.description: pip install kanbus==0.33.0 fails with 'Cannot uninstall PyYAML 6.0.1, RECORD file not found' because PyYAML is Debian-installed, so the SessionStart hook silently leaves kbs missing. Workaround that works: python3 -m venv, install the pinned kanbus there, symlink kbs. Fix: have the script create and use a venv (or pip install --ignore-installed). Also: kbs prompts about agent provenance; pass --agent-platform/--agent-model/--agent-name.
